scenes.headline: Why is the sky blue?
scenes.narration: Sunlight looks white, so why does the sky turn blue every single day?

scenes.headline: Blue light scatters most
scenes.narration: Air scatters short blue waves far more than long red ones, so blue reaches your eyes from everywhere.

scenes.headline: Look up tonight
scenes.narration: Next time you see a sunset, remember the same trick makes the sky red.
